sum.description: Sum of all values in the population. If no values, this will be zero.

count.description: Number of valid values in the population.

avg.description: Arithmetic mean of the values, also called the "average."

variance.description:
Measure of dispersion of the population values; the average of the squares of the differences from the mean
(using _n - 1_ in the denominator).

stddev.description: Standard deviation, the square root of the variance (using _n - 1_ in the denominator).

median.description: Value separating the higher from the lower half of the population values.

quartiles.description:
Three points separating the population values into four ranges with an equal number of values.
The values in the array are:
 - point that only ¼ of the values are below (first quartile)
 - point that half the values are above and half below (median)
 - point that only ¼ of the values are above (third quartile)
Note that this means the index is one smaller than the rank, `quartiles[0]` is the _first_ quartile.

deciles.description:
Nine points separating the population values into ten ranges with an equal number of values. The first element is
the first decile and the last (ninth) value is the ninth decile. Note that this means the index is one smaller
then the rank, `deciles[0]` is the _first_ decile (point that only ⅒ of the values are below).

percentiles.description:
The population values separated into one hundred ranges with an equal number of values. The first element is
the first percentile and the last value is the hundreth percentile. Note that this means the index is one smaller
then the rank, `percentile[0]` is the _first_ percentile (point that only 1/100 of the values are below).
